verdict.rationale: Neon runs headlessly and in CI. Its CLI ran keylessly via npx in a runtime probe and supports unattended setup with `-y --agent`. neon.ts plan/apply logic can be called "from your own script or CI job" via @neon/config-runtime, and the Management API with scoped API keys allows fully automated project creation and cleanup. Missing for 10: detailed CI pipeline docs (the GitHub integration appears only as a title) and independent hands-on corroboration of an actual CI run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: To call the same `inspect` / `plan` / `apply` logic from your own script or CI job instead of the CLI, see `@neon/config-runtime`.
pass -y and --agent for an unattended agent setup
the official Neon CLI ran keylessly from npm — `npx -y neon@latest --version` printed `4.14.1` with no account
Project creation, configuration, and cleanup are fully automated
you can test sign-up, login, and OAuth flows in preview or CI branches without touching production
